GENERAL CHECKS

1. GT Inspection.

cells.value: State of SV mounts for cracks/bulge & application of Nicol Lacquer

Check instrumentation and gauges for satisfactory working.
Intactness of rubber coaming on GT casing
Material state of turn buckles of IVGVA mechanism & reversing cylinder
GT casing doors and their locking
Contains KHLADON 227 EA at 40 kgf/Cm² Check conditions of bottles. Bottles should not be rusted
Rubber is not torn, flaking or hard. Baffles are intact and corrosion free.
Wire mesh is clean. Mesh and guards are corrosion free and intact.
Clean and free from rust marks & foreign material.
Drain line is clear and no water accumulation in tray.
Lagging work is intact and all perforated sheets are secured properly with tag welding of securing nuts.
Check for correct functioning of locking arrangement. Check condition of rubber coaming.
Check presence of water in the hydraulic seal. Fill hydraulic seal with fresh water
Check the perforated sheet of air supply duct.
The position of IVGVA to be -15. IVGVA to be free from rust.
Check condition of exhaust duct for securing arrangement and rust marks & survey Check for carbon soot formation and clear if required.
Check all interconnecting valves are operational.
Check system pipes are secured properly.
Air pressure in the cylinders of the air systems
Check the air pressure in the cylinders of the air systems, which shall be at least 150 kgf/Cm²
Check ШПM compressed air tightness checks. Check Air filling indication (ONCE IN 15 MIN ALLOWED).
Check valves and fittings for freedom of movement.
Check fuel level in gravity tank, should not be below 3/4 level.

Ensure pressure gauges before and after filters are in working condition. Check filter difference across filters, should be less than 1.5 & 1.0 Kgf/Cm² for CT-500 & ΦHT filters respectively. Check filter body for corrosion and leakages. Check the date of last replacement, both filters elements to be renewed six monthly.
Fine fuel filter, starting fuel igniter , flow restrictors
Check filter difference across filter, should be less than 1.0 Kgf/Cm Check filter body for corrosion and leakages.
Check for presence of metal particles.
Tank to be cleaned as per MAINTOPs and suitable entries to be made respective log book. Tank level gauges to be in good working conditions.
Start the fuel booster pump; check the fuel pressure, which should be 1.8 to 3.0 kgf/Cm²
Check oil level in circulating tanks, normal amount of oil should be in CGT 300-350 kgf, BGT 250-300 kgf, CRG 2000-2600 kgf, BRG 2600-3200
Check for leakages, corrosion and securing clamps.
Check availability of lab equipment and chemicals of salinity checks.
Check operation of lub oil pump units of GT & RG systems.
Check level, tank should be clear.
Check gauge glass is clean and level is visible.
Last change date, should be checked every quarterly & to be renewed if deteriorated more than 50%, Renewed every six monthly.
Check valves and fittings for freedom of movement.

PART III – SEA PHASE
SECTION - A
1.TRIAL SCHEDULE

cells.value: Record starting characteristics and idling parameter of engines.
Rev up both Cruise engines to 13200 HPC RPM
Stabilise for 15 min and Record Vibration and check slip
Rev up both Cruise engines to ‘+’ indication of IVGVA.
Build up 13200 HPC rpm on running cruise engine
Start Boost engines and Shut down Cruise engines.
Record starting characteristics of Boost and RDT of Cruise engines.
Adjust Boost engine regime to 8 kgf/cm² of HPC outlet air pressure
Stabilise for 15 min and record Balance chamber pressures, adjust if required.
Stabilise for 30 min and record PT balance chamber pressure. Adjust, if necessary
Change mode to ahead. Rev up both Boost engines to 7400 HPC RPM.
Stabilise for 15 min. Record parameters and vibration signatures. Check slip.
Start Cruise engines and connect up.
Stabilise for 15 min. And connect Cruise engines in speed II.
Rev up CGTs to 1.25N & BGTs to 0.8N
Stabilise for 15 min and record parameters.
Rev up CGTs to 1.5N & BGTs to 1.0N

the following updted documents should be made available before commencement of trials -

  • (a) Service log of all equipment of GTA
  • (b) EMAP relevant to MGTAs parameters
  • (c) Record of all adjustment made to elements of engines. RGs and controls
  • Ships displacement and Drafts. State of POLs onboard SI no 10 & 11 will be undertaken during FPT.

During vibration signature ensure following -

  • Steady course and regime should be maintained.
  • Wheel over 5° to be avoided.
  • Gun trials / helo operation / maneuvering to be taken.
  • Sl no. 10 & 11 will be undertaken during FPT.
  • log ships speed during each engine

Engine room overhead and below platform to be fully illuminated

Record of lube oil replacement for all 04 GTs to be provided
